English:
Heya, <Mint>. I want
you to teach me how to cook.

You can't? I dunno what to do, 'cause I
screw it up all the time. It's getting so old.

Don't stress on it. Everyone has
their strong and weak points, so--

Yes, that's right! I think you
should just keep at what you do best.

Mmm... If that's what you think,
I guess that's what I'll do. Thanks!
